=== DOCS-TRUTH VERIFIED (against trino.io/docs/467/sql/select.html + AWS re:Post Athena-Trino error message) ===
• (a) max_recursion_depth default = 10 — VERIFIED verbatim from trino.io/docs/current/sql/select.html: "recursion depth is fixed, defaults to `10`, and doesn't depend on the actual query results".
• (b) Exceeding the cap RAISES AN ERROR — VERIFIED via AWS re:Post (Athena uses the same Trino engine): exact error message is `NOT_SUPPORTED: Recursion depth limit exceeded (10). Use 'max_recursion_depth'`. The engine does NOT silently truncate.
• (c) WITH RECURSIVE supported in Trino 467 — VERIFIED: introduced in Trino 340 (8 Aug 2020) per PR #4250 and release-340.html (well before 467, so always available on this stack); experimental-flag note verbatim: "This feature is experimental only. Proceed to use it only if you understand potential query failures and the impact of the recursion processing on your workload."
• (d) Quadratic-plan-growth note verbatim: "When changing the value consider that the size of the query plan growth is quadratic with the recursion depth."
